I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I said I've noted her correction and will use it in place of the Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date she posted in #north-team this morning. My reply didn't repeat the new date, and I took no other action, since she said none was needed.

The corrected date is 10 June. That's an operational fact Ilse posted in that channel herself, so repeating it there later would be fine. I didn't look at #north-team or any other records.
